title: David Worth, Director of ‘Kickboxer’ and DP of ‘Any Which Way You Can,’ Dies at 86
content:
ByPat Saperstein

Deputy Editor

David Worth, director of films including “Kickboxer” and DP on numerous films including Clint Eastwood’s “Any Which Way You Can,” died Sept. 4 in Sunland, Calif. He was 86.

Worth started out as director of photography on low-budget movies before Clint Eastwood hired him as cinematographer on “Bronco Billy” and “Any Which Way You Can,” both released in 1980.

After serving as director of photography on Jean-Claude Van Damme’s “Bloodsport,” he moved into directing, with 1989’s “Kickboxer” starring Van Damme. Worth went on to direct several episodes of the “Air America” TV series and features including “Shark Attack 2” and “Shark Attack 3.”

Among the other films he shot were “China Cry: A True Story,” “Lady Dragon,” “American Tigers,” “Raptor Island,” “Man With the Screaming Brain” and “Alien Apocalypse.”

“His work was also his joy, and his family frequently joined him on location around the world during his long career,” his daughter Christina said, “He was irreverent, funny, and in jovial spirits to the very end.”

Worth was also an author, teacher, and received his master’s degree in 2016. His books include “Milestones in Cinema: 50 Visionary Films & Filmmakers,” “Orson Welles Crash Course in Cinematography and “Zen & the Art of Independent Filmmaking (a cautionary tale).”

He is survived by his daughter, Chrystina Myers, a son, David Wertheimer, a brother and two grandsons.Van Damme remembered Worth on Instagram, writing: “I am deeply saddened by the passing of my friend David Worth. From ‘Bloodsport’ to ‘Kickboxer,’ David’s talent and vision helped create two martial arts classics that changed my life.”
title_zh: 《踢拳者》(Kickboxer)的導演大衛·沃斯(David Worth)及《隨心所欲》(Any Which Way You Can)的攝影指導，於86歲時去世。
content_zh:
由帕特·薩珀斯坦(Pat Saperstein)報導

副編輯

大衛·沃斯(David Worth)，曾執導《踢拳者》(Kickboxer)等電影，並擔任多部影片的攝影指導，包括克林特·伊斯特伍德(Clint Eastwood)的《隨心所欲》(Any Which Way You Can)，於9月4日在加州桑蘭德(Sunland)去世，享年86歲。

沃斯最初在低預算電影中擔任攝影指導，後來被克林特·伊斯特伍德聘為《布朗科·比利》(Bronco Billy)和《隨心所欲》(Any Which Way You Can)的攝影指導，兩部影片均於1980年上映。

在擔任尚-克勞德·范·達美(Jean-Claude Van Damme)的《血戰》(Bloodsport)的攝影指導後，他轉向導演，並於1989年執導了由范·達美主演的《踢拳者》(Kickboxer)。沃斯還執導了多集《空中美人》(Air America)電視劇，以及《鯊魚攻擊2》(Shark Attack 2)和《鯊魚攻擊3》(Shark Attack 3)等電影。

他拍攝的其他影片包括《中國哭泣：真實故事》(China Cry: A True Story)、《女龍》(Lady Dragon)、《美國老虎》(American Tigers)、《猛禽島》(Raptor Island)、《尖叫的腦袋》(Man With the Screaming Brain)和《外星人末日》(Alien Apocalypse)。

他的女兒克里斯蒂娜(Christina)表示：“他的工作也是他的樂趣，家人經常在他漫長的職業生涯中陪伴他在世界各地拍攝。他不拘一格、幽默風趣，直到最後都保持著愉快的心情。”

沃斯還是一位作家和教師，並於2016年獲得碩士學位。他的著作包括《電影里程碑：50部具前瞻性的電影與電影製作人》(Milestones in Cinema: 50 Visionary Films & Filmmakers)、《奧森·威爾斯的攝影指導速成班》(Orson Welles Crash Course in Cinematography)和《獨立電影製作的禪與藝術》(Zen & the Art of Independent Filmmaking)（一個警示故事）。

他留下了女兒克里斯蒂娜·邁爾斯(Chrystina Myers)、兒子大衛·沃特海默(David Wertheimer)、一位兄弟和兩位孫子。范·達美在Instagram上懷念沃斯，寫道：“我對我的朋友大衛·沃斯的去世感到深深的悲痛。從《血戰》(Bloodsport)到《踢拳者》(Kickboxer)，大衛的才華和視野幫助創造了兩部改變我人生的武術經典。”

由帕特·薩珀斯坦(Pat Saperstein)報導

副編輯

大衛·沃斯(David Worth)，曾執導《踢拳者》(Kickboxer)等電影，並擔任多部影片的攝影指導，包括克林特·伊斯特伍德(Clint Eastwood)的《隨心所欲》(Any Which Way You Can)，於9月4日在加州桑蘭德(Sunland)去世，享年86歲。
